title: S3 Bucket Public ACL Misconfiguration Campaign
description: Active scanning for publicly listable buckets and ACL bypass patterns.

policyDecision.reasoning: No existing approved policy covers public ACL block plus continuous monitoring for this campaign.

title: IAM Privilege Escalation via Overly Broad Roles
description: Attackers chaining PassRole with wildcard resource policies.

policyDecision.reasoning: Approved S3 policy already has IAM controls; tighten CTRL-IAM-02 scope.

title: Azure Functions Auth Token Replay
description: Observed token replay attempts against function endpoints.

policyDecision.reasoning: Draft Azure Functions policy needs short-lived tokens and audience validation.

title: GCP Storage Exfiltration via Unrestricted Egress
description: Data staging to external sinks using open egress paths.

policyDecision.reasoning: Rejected GCP policy lacked network controls; new policy should include CTRL-NET-01.
